subject: Candidate urgent: allergic reaction overnight — need to reschedule today's interview
messages:
From: Emma Choe <emma.choe@example.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Today's interview — I'm not well

Hi Connor,

I'm really sorry to send this last-minute, but I had a pretty bad allergic reaction overnight and had to go to urgent care. I'm still feeling lightheaded and the doctor advised rest for the day. I don't think I'll be able to do the scheduled screen at 10am today.

I've attached a quick photo of the discharge note and a receipt for the taxi (er_note.jpg, taxi_receipt.pdf). I know this is inconvenient — I'm very interested in the role and would like to reschedule as soon as possible. I'm available Mon/Tue afternoons next week (PST), or I can do a take-home code exercise if that's easier.

Apologies again and thanks for understanding,
Emma Choe
emma.choe@example.com
+1 (415) 555-0193
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Emma Choe <emma.choe@example.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Today's interview — I'm not well

Emma — thanks for the heads up and I'm really sorry to hear you had to go to urgent care. Priority is getting you rested — we'll pause the interview for today.

Options:
- We can move the live screen to Tuesday (5/31) or Wednesday (6/1) afternoon PST — please confirm preferred day/time.
- If you'd rather not do another live session, we can send a short take-home coding exercise with a 48-hour window.

On the expense side, we can reimburse reasonable taxi/urgent care costs. Please send the receipts (you already attached a taxi receipt and a photo of the discharge note; that's sufficient for now). Marissa, can you confirm the fastest way to get Emma the reimbursement (Venmo/bank/email reimbursement form)?

Irene — tagging you for panel availability. If we reschedule, would Monday afternoon be okay or do you prefer later in the week? The original panel: Irene (hiring manager), Marissa (swe), and Jonah (infra) — Jonah is flexible but wants a heads up.

Emma — feel better, and we'll get you a new slot that doesn't add stress.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 (617) 555-0132
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Today's interview — I'm not well

Thanks for the ping, Connor — and poor Emma, hope she recovers quickly. I'm fine with rescheduling later this week; my calendar is open Tue/Wed 1–4pm PST. If Emma prefers the take-home exercise to reduce pressure, I'm okay evaluating that first and doing a shorter follow-up call.

Marissa — please hold a 90-minute slot Tue 2–3:30pm PST tentatively while we confirm. Also happy to approve the reimbursement — no need for a formal expense ticket for the small taxi/urgent care receipts; we can do a one-off via payroll. Marissa, can you confirm process and reach out to Emma?

Connor: please let Jonah know he'll likely be slotted for the 2:00–2:30pm panel segment; he appreciates 24h notice.

Irene
Irene Choi
Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
From: Emma Choe <emma.choe@example.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Today's interview — I'm not well

Thanks so much, Connor and Irene. I appreciate the quick responses.

I'll take the take-home exercise to avoid rushing a live session — that will be easier while I recover. I'm available Tue 5/31 after 1:30pm PST and Wed 6/1 after 2pm PST if you later need a live follow-up.

I've attached the taxi receipt and a clearer photo of the urgent care note (er_note.jpg, taxi_receipt.pdf). For reimbursement, Venmo or a direct ACH transfer would work best for me — Venmo handle is @emma-choe. Happy to fill out any short form if needed.

Thanks again for being flexible — I look forward to the next steps.

Warmly,
Emma Choe
emma.choe@example.com
+1 (415) 555-0193
